source.title: Infernal Greatlock Girdle - LIVE Wowhead item-side Looter aggregate
source.author: Wowhead Looter pooled submission

notes: LIVE Wowhead item-side Looter aggregate shows 12 reported disenchants and two separate same-name Dawn Crystal rows (9/12 and 3/12). These output rows may differ by material rank, but linked output IDs/ranks are not visible: do not merge rows, guess rank or promote to current-patch numeric baseline. Source-at-cast item level/bonus, enchant skill, specialization, event dates, units per hit, per-cast zero bins and 0/1/2+ histograms are unknown. Selected Wowhead preview item level 289 is NOT measured gear level at disenchant. 12.1.5 PTR view shows 11 with 9/2, likely overlapping/mutable Looter snapshots, not another independent cohort. This is reference-only, not an independently verified current Retail event ledger.
